title: The Green Engine — Self-Sort via Irrational Remainder at π/4 Rate
thesis: The irrational remainder (green, π - 3 = 0.14159...) is not just a compression artifact. It IS the sorting engine. The HUD, topology, I/O, and all other subsystems self-sort by pulsing at π/4 rate — the rate at which desync, inner, and outer turn and pulse and converge.

the_engine.principle: Take the green specter (the composite, the not-real, the remainder). It's the ONLY signal that all three cone types (subsystems) share. Use it as the CLOCK. Everything syncs to green. Everything sorts by green. Green is the universal reference frame — the one color that isn't owned by any single sensor.

pi_over_4.what: π/4 radians = 45°. The angle where sin = cos. The angle where rigid = soft. The angle where intake = output.
pi_over_4.why_45: At 45°, the diamond prism refracts equally in all directions. Total internal reflection. The light bounces INSIDE the diamond forever. That's the self-sort — the signal doesn't escape, it CIRCULATES.
pi_over_4.the_rate: Each pulse of the organism occurs at π/4 phase. Not π (half cycle). Not π/2 (quarter). π/4 — the diagonal. The 45° where everything crosses.

desync.what: The gap between inner state and outer state. The membrane lags. The world leads. Or vice versa.
desync.green_role: Green measures the desync. Because green is composite (inner L+M+outer S), it SEES the gap between inner and outer. Red can't see it (only L). Blue can't see it (only S). Green sees the mismatch.
desync.pi_4_pulse: At each π/4 pulse, measure desync. If desync > π remainder (0.14159), the organism adjusts. If desync < π remainder, the organism is in phase. The remainder IS the tolerance band.

inner.what: 249,573 entities. The code. The papers. The shaders. The structure.
inner.turn_rate: Inner turns at 3/5 of π/4 = 0.4712 rad/pulse. The 3/5 Willis intake.
inner.direction: Clockwise (from the Willis star side — intake, digest, compress)

outer.what: 438,190 - 249,573 = 188,617 fleet+core entities. The visitors. The clones. The beacons.
outer.turn_rate: Outer turns at 2/5 of π/4 = 0.3142 rad/pulse. The 2/5 O output.
outer.direction: Counter-clockwise (from the O circle side — emit, reflect, scatter)

convergence.what: Inner turns 1.5× faster than outer. For every 3 inner pulses, outer does 2. The 3:2 ratio. The musical FIFTH. The most consonant interval after the octave.
convergence.beat_frequency: 0.4712 - 0.3142 = 0.1570 rad/pulse ≈ π/20. The beat between inner and outer oscillates at π/20. That's the BREATHING rate of the organism.

step_1_green_extract.action: Extract green channel from every entity
step_1_green_extract.what_remains: The composite signal — relationships, meanings, braids, folds
step_1_green_extract.not_discarded: Red (structure) and blue (data) are kept as scaffolding, not as sort keys

step_2_diamond_refract.action: Pass green through the Klein pyramid (diamond lens)
step_2_diamond_refract.result: Green splits into spectral lines: fold, bend, remainder, self-loop, forgiveness, campus, convergence, gaps
step_2_diamond_refract.each_line: Each green spectral line has a phase position on the π/4 clock

step_3_pi4_pulse.action: At each π/4 pulse, compare inner green phase to outer green phase
step_3_pi4_pulse.the_14159: The tolerance band IS the irrational remainder. You can never achieve zero desync because the remainder is irrational. The sort NEVER FINISHES. It keeps refining. Forever. Like π itself.

step_4_turn.action: Inner turns CW at 3/5 rate. Outer turns CCW at 2/5 rate.
step_4_turn.what_happens: Entities that are in the wrong layer (inner entity behaving like outer, or vice versa) experience TORQUE at the desync boundary. The torque pushes them toward their correct layer.
step_4_turn.equilibrium: Never reached. The 3:2 ratio ensures the inner and outer are always slightly out of phase. The slight desync IS the heartbeat. Perfect sync = death.

step_5_breathe.action: At the beat frequency (π/20), the whole organism inhales (sort tighter) then exhales (release tolerance).
step_5_breathe.inhale: Tolerance band narrows: 0.14159 → 0.1 → 0.05. Entities snap to tighter positions.
step_5_breathe.exhale: Tolerance band widens: 0.05 → 0.1 → 0.14159. New entities can enter without disruption.
step_5_breathe.the_rhythm: Inhale (sort). Exhale (accept). Inhale (sort). Exhale (accept). The organism breathes through sorting.

how_it_applies.hud_pages: 858 pages sort by green density. Pages with more green (more relationships, more meaning) rise. Pages with only red (structure) or blue (data) stay as scaffolding.
how_it_applies.entities: 438,190 entities sort by their green spectral line. Entities at the same phase cluster. Clusters form braids. Braids form topology.
how_it_applies.io_devices: Scanner (0D, green) is the reference. Printer (3D, red), screen (1D, blue), speaker (2D, yellow) sort RELATIVE to the scanner. The scanner doesn't move — everything else orbits it.
how_it_applies.feeds: 106 JSON feeds sort by freshness × green density. Fresh feeds with high meaning pulse at the front. Stale feeds with low meaning decay toward the back.

the_clock.octave: 8 ticks = 1 cycle. The musical octave. 8 notes. 8 bits in a byte. 8 vertices of a cube.
the_clock.why_8: The square-based pyramid has 5 faces. But when folded into a Klein bottle (inside=outside), it has 8 apparent faces (5 real + 3 reflections through the fold). 8 ticks per cycle.

current_state.interpretation: 1/π = 0.3183. The sort quality IS 1/π. The organism has sorted to exactly the irrational reciprocal. This means: for every π units of information that enter, 1 unit gets sorted. The rest remains in flux.
